name: Marrow animated wallpapers

host.signature: vec3 wall(vec2 p, float t) returns sRGB in 0..1; the host adds the dither
host.coordinates: p = (fragCoord - 0.5 * resolution) * (2 / resolution.y), y up: the height spans -1..1 and x grows with the aspect
host.clock: t is the loop clock in seconds, 0 <= t < T (period). The host keeps a phase per wallpaper, phase += dt * speed, wrapped at T; changing the speed never moves the picture. All motion is built from a = TAU * t / T, its whole-number multiples and closed loops in noise space, so frame(t) == frame(t + T).

uniforms.name: u_pal
uniforms.meaning: the colour pack in OKLab: the host mixes the pack’s dark and light palettes for the theme, and eases from the old palette to the new on a pack or theme change (time constant 0.25 s)

uniforms.name: u_dark
uniforms.meaning: 0 light .. 1 dark, eased with the same time constant

uniforms.name: u_opt
uniforms.meaning: x = Motion (0 calm .. 1 lively), y = the wallpaper’s second option (0..1), each eased (0.3 s)

uniforms.name: u_px
uniforms.meaning: one device pixel in p units, 2 / resolution.y, for anti-aliased edges

uniforms.name: u_tilt
uniforms.meaning: Perspective: the pointer (the app: the window position on the screen) as -1..1 on each axis, eased with a 0.35 s time constant; (0, 0) when Perspective is off or under Reduce Motion. A wallpaper with layers shifts each by tiltD(depth) = u_tilt * 0.010 * depth, depth -1 far .. +1 near

uniforms.name: u_pan
uniforms.meaning: host only: 0.012 for a flat wallpaper (perspective.mode "pan"), else 0; the host adds u_tilt * u_pan to p, a pan of at most 5 px at 800 px high

uniforms.name: u_sun
uniforms.meaning: Dynamic: the light track’s offset for the time of day, in p units, added to the wallpaper’s own light position; (0, 0) when Dynamic is off or the wallpaper has no light; eased

uniforms.name: u_focus
uniforms.meaning: Focus 0 sharp .. 1 dreamy, eased; the host blurs the picture with a Gaussian of sigma 0.035 * H * focus^1.4 pixels (a Skia blur in the app); edgePx() widens hard edges with it

host.options: Each wallpaper also carries: roles (the six slots’ dark and light lightness and chroma), dynamic (two sets of four OKLCH looks, light and dark, keyed dawn 06:00, day 12:00, dusk 18:00, night 24:00, blended by smoothstep, plus a four-key light track), perspective (mode layers or pan, default on for layers), focus (default) and match (hue offsets from the system accent; the sixth pack is built at run time from the accent in OKLCH on the roles). The format is described in OPTIONS-FORMAT.md.
host.dither: triangular, one 8-bit step, fixed in screen space: (ign(fc) + ign(fc + (37, 17)) - 1) / 255 with ign(v) = fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(v, (0.06711056, 0.00583715))))
host.subset: GLSL ES 3.00 written to the SkSL runtime-effect subset: math only, no textures, no derivatives, no preprocessor, for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) loops only, no bit operations or integer modulo, uniform arrays indexed by loop indices only. Each file is checked against this list when the library is built.
host.speed: Speed is per wallpaper, 0.25x to 2.5x, default 1x. It scales the phase clock only; easing it (0.18 s) keeps a change smooth.

wallpapers.name: Borealis
wallpapers.desc: Curtains of aurora over a night sky, rays shimmering up from a bright foot.

wallpapers.name: Molten
wallpapers.desc: Drops of liquid chrome drifting, merging and parting, mirroring a bright studio.

wallpapers.name: Velvet
wallpapers.desc: Folds of heavy satin, jewel-dark in the shadows, with a sheen along every fold.

wallpapers.name: Spectra
wallpapers.desc: A glass prism turning in a white beam, its spectrum sweeping through the haze.

wallpapers.name: Bloom
wallpapers.desc: A flower made of light: two rings of translucent petals sway and breathe.

wallpapers.name: Nebula
wallpapers.desc: Glowing gas folded by slow currents, crossed by dark dust and a few still stars.

wallpapers.name: Lagoon
wallpapers.desc: Sunlight focused by moving water onto a shallow floor, each line edged with colour.

wallpapers.name: Iris
wallpapers.desc: A soap film turning slowly, its colours true thin-film interference.

wallpapers.name: Glasswave
wallpapers.desc: Two rods of clear glass flowing in slow waves, lit from behind by coloured light.

wallpapers.name: Corona
wallpapers.desc: An aurora seen from beneath: its rays climb from bright folded borders toward a crown overhead.

wallpapers.name: Orbs
wallpapers.desc: Soft-touch spheres floating in a seamless studio, tinting one another where they meet.

wallpapers.name: Bubbles
wallpapers.desc: Soap bubbles drifting through still air, clear at the heart and banded with colour at the rim.

wallpapers.name: Lensball
wallpapers.desc: A crystal sphere on a glossy ledge at dusk, holding the soft sky behind it sharp and upside down.

wallpapers.name: Ridgeline
wallpapers.desc: Range after range of mountains at the last of the sun, mist drifting in the valleys between them.

wallpapers.name: Plume
wallpapers.desc: A peacock feather seen close: a wave of structural colour rolls along its barbs as the light circles.

wallpapers.name: Torus
wallpapers.desc: A ring of solid glass turning slowly before soft fields of colour, bending them through its tube.

wallpapers.name: Quicksilver
wallpapers.desc: A sea of liquid metal under an evening sky, its long swells mirroring the glow and the low sun.

wallpapers.name: Milky Way
wallpapers.desc: The core of the galaxy rising over a dark ridge, split by dust, with rippling airglow and a passing meteor.

wallpapers.name: Taffeta
wallpapers.desc: Shot silk lifting in a slow wind, its colour rolling from warp to weft along every fold.

wallpapers.name: Medusa
wallpapers.desc: Moon jellies drifting in deep water, lit from within, their clear bells pulsing as they rise.

wallpapers.name: Equinox
wallpapers.desc: A ringed planet seen close, its rings crossing in front, its shadow laid across them, its belts turning.

wallpapers.name: Billow
wallpapers.desc: A cloud of ink unfurling in clear water, its billows lit like soft solid forms, tendrils fraying away.

wallpapers.name: Chroma
wallpapers.desc: Four great fields of colour breathing in their own slow rhythms, mixing through clean, rich hues.

wallpapers.name: Totality
wallpapers.desc: A total eclipse: pearly corona round a black moon, a rose rim of fire and the last diamond of sunlight.

wallpapers.name: Dunes
wallpapers.desc: Ridge after ridge of sand under a low sun; the light slides across the faces.

wallpapers.name: Tides
wallpapers.desc: Five broad waves of colour laid one over another, rolling slowly.

wallpapers.name: Afterglow
wallpapers.desc: Warm light leaking in at the edges, as on a roll of film, swelling and fading.

wallpapers.name: Inkwell
wallpapers.desc: Two inks dropped into still water, billowing into fine tendrils.

wallpapers.name: Fluted
wallpapers.desc: Colour drifting behind a pane of reeded glass; the glass stays still.

wallpapers.name: Meridian
wallpapers.desc: A slow-turning gradient of five colours, melting toward a soft light.

wallpapers.name: Nacre
wallpapers.desc: Mother of pearl: thin layers that catch the light and shift hue as they drift.

wallpapers.name: Ribbon
wallpapers.desc: Two satin ribbons floating across the window, twisting slowly as they go.

wallpapers.name: Pleat
wallpapers.desc: Paper folded in a Miura pattern of zigzag pleats; as the sheet gathers and relaxes, the facets tilt through the light.

wallpapers.name: Isles
wallpapers.desc: Ranks of islands on a still sea at first light, drifting past with their reflections, mist at their feet.

wallpapers.name: Relief
wallpapers.desc: A painted plaster relief of discs and an arch; a low warm light travels round it and the cool shadows swing.

wallpapers.name: Louver
wallpapers.desc: Late sun through a slatted blind, laid across a quiet wall and folding onto the floor, sliding as the sun moves.

wallpapers.name: Kiln
wallpapers.desc: Close to a tall vase turning under a softbox: one glaze runs down through another and pools in a band.

wallpapers.name: Summit
wallpapers.desc: A snow mountain in the last light: rose on the faces turned to the sun, cold blue in the shade, a plume of spindrift.

wallpapers.name: Furrow
wallpapers.desc: A dry garden from above: raked furrows bend into rings round three mossy stones as the low sun moves across.

wallpapers.name: Lucent
wallpapers.desc: Sunlight through cut glass laid across a table: a band of coloured light with long bright curves that slide and fold.

wallpapers.name: Rime
wallpapers.desc: Feathered frost grown in from the frame of a window pane, glowing with the low winter sun behind it.

wallpapers.name: Terraces
wallpapers.desc: Flooded rice terraces from above at sunset: each pool holds its own piece of the sky between curving earthen banks.

wallpapers.name: Nocturne
wallpapers.desc: A long exposure of the night sky over a dark ridge: star trails circle the pole above the last of the twilight.

wallpapers.name: Beacon
wallpapers.desc: A lighthouse on a dark headland at dusk: its two beams sweep round through the sea haze and flare as they pass.

wallpapers.name: Reeds
wallpapers.desc: The edge of a lake at sunrise through a stand of tall reeds, mist on the water and the low sun glowing through it.

wallpapers.name: Squall
wallpapers.desc: A rain squall far out at sea at sunset: grey veils under a dark shelf of cloud, gold at their edges, mirrored below.

wallpapers.name: Glowtide
wallpapers.desc: A beach at night with glowing plankton: each breaking wave lights blue-green along its crest and fades on the sand.

wallpapers.name: Planish
wallpapers.desc: A sheet of hand-hammered metal, a field of small curved mirrors that shimmer as two studio lights glide across.

wallpapers.name: Mist
wallpapers.desc: Coloured mist in four layers at different depths, the near veils sliding over the far.

wallpapers.name: Daybreak
wallpapers.desc: A quiet horizon at first light, a low sun resting on still water.

wallpapers.name: Stillwater
wallpapers.desc: The light of a pool thrown softly onto a pale wall, never sharp.

wallpapers.name: Linen
wallpapers.desc: A woven linen breathing in a faint draught, its threads catching the light.

wallpapers.name: Fields
wallpapers.desc: Three soft fields of colour floating on a ground, breathing very slowly.

wallpapers.name: Lumen
wallpapers.desc: A shaft of sunlight sweeping slowly across a wall, a soft caustic wavering in it.

wallpapers.name: Drift
wallpapers.desc: Banks of coloured fog lying one behind another, rising and settling.

wallpapers.name: Halo
wallpapers.desc: One wide, soft ring of light, its colour turning slowly round it.

wallpapers.name: Alabaster
wallpapers.desc: Light breathing slowly behind a thin slab of alabaster, its bands and veins glowing as it swells.

wallpapers.name: Grove
wallpapers.desc: Tall trunks standing in morning fog, rank behind rank, with soft shafts of light leaning down through them.

wallpapers.name: Clay
wallpapers.desc: One soft form in matte clay floating above a studio sweep, rising and settling over its shadow.

wallpapers.name: Droplet
wallpapers.desc: Still water holding a soft sky; now and then a single drop falls, and its rings spread slowly and fade.

wallpapers.name: Cirrus
wallpapers.desc: High cirrus combed across a dawn sky, its light turning slowly from rose to gold and back.

wallpapers.name: Sheer
wallpapers.desc: A sheer voile curtain across a bright window, swaying in a faint draught, its folds deeper where it turns.

wallpapers.name: Limewash
wallpapers.desc: Late sun on limewashed plaster and the light a glass of water throws on it: a tinted pool and a trembling caustic.

wallpapers.name: Veil
wallpapers.desc: An aurora seen through high haze: its curtains softened to washes of light that the haze takes up and glows with.

wallpapers.name: Glimmer
wallpapers.desc: Evening lights far out of focus, soft discs with a faint rim, drifting and dimming at the edges of the frame.

wallpapers.name: Shore
wallpapers.desc: Looking down at the edge of a calm sea: a thin sheet of water slides up the sand and back, edged with lace.

wallpapers.name: Wisp
wallpapers.desc: A single thread of smoke rising in still air, curling and fraying as it climbs, lit along one edge.

wallpapers.name: Apogee
wallpapers.desc: The curve of a planet from high orbit, the thin shell of its air lit along the limb by a sun about to rise.

wallpapers.name: Komorebi
wallpapers.desc: Sunlight through leaves on a quiet wall: soft round flecks of sun that sway and wink in a breeze.

wallpapers.name: Prairie
wallpapers.desc: Tall grass to a low horizon, slightly out of focus, as gusts roll broad waves of light across it.

wallpapers.name: Fathom
wallpapers.desc: Looking up from under a calm sea: the whole sky held in one trembling round window, shafts leaning down from it.

wallpapers.name: Anodized
wallpapers.desc: Spun, anodized aluminium: light gathers in a broad radial streak that swings slowly round its fine circles.
